County truck in dip with lights on and men on board logged 23:10, passed to police only, not passed to boat crews. Boat 7 located truck 05:10 after Sam rescue, assessment deferred due to Boat 7 out of service.

Handover summary for relief: Boat 4 on water at dam with limited fuel, Boat 7 out of service, Ken deceased underpass, Ellen deceased low street, packing plant two missing, trailer park one unaccounted, Sam recovered, Travis and Wade recovered, Roy recovered.
